proposedFix: None on V21. The fixture is malformed: it hand-stamps AttributeMultiplierPct__c=50 onto an output-typed QLI field and creates no QuoteLineItemAttribute records, while Fortra PCI Scanning has no PADs and no PriceAdjustmentSchedule, so attribute-calculated pricing cannot hydrate a multiplier. To validate Calculated mode legitimately: pick a product genuinely configured for price-impacting attribute pricing (PADs + PriceAdjustmentSchedule), configure the attribute so the AttributeBasedPrice element (V21 step 11) hydrates Attribute_Multiplier_Pct__c as a calculation output, and correct the expected value to match V21's documented Calculated-mode behavior (floors to Base_Price__c when no multiplier applies).
notes: ADVERSARIAL REFUTATION of the executor's dual-PROCEDURE-DEFECT claim. (1) Context fieldType=output on Attribute_Multiplier_Pct__c is CONFIRMED live but is NOT a defect: the multiplier is a computed OUTPUT of attribute pricing (sourced from PADs/PriceAdjustmentSchedule via step 11), not a pre-stamped per-line input. The control line disproves the executor's logic: it has mult=null too, yet prices to 100 (output-fieldType does not cause $0). (2) The CalculatedMode NetBridge IF(NetUnitPrice>0,NetUnitPrice,InputUnitPrice) is CONFIRMED live and does differ from the TotalPrice/UnitPrice modes (which fall to Base_Price__c), but the asymmetry is intentional: Calculated mode's output IS InputUnitPrice=Base x multiplier. The $0 traces to upstream NetUnitPrice never seeding on these fixture lines, NOT to the bridge. Preflight FAILS: product has 0 PADs / 0 PriceAdjustmentSchedule / 0 QLIA, so a real UI rep could not build this scenario on PCI Scanning. The executor's preflight claim of '3 PADs active IsPriceImpacting=true' is FALSE (live = 0 for this product). Per METHOD_BRIEF: malformed fixture + branch ran on un-hydratable inputs => BLOCKED/TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT, never FAIL. Expected=50 is also an EXPECTATION-ERROR (working V21 floors to Base=100). Regression tag SC-3390 dropped (no live defect to attribute to it).
